title: Why Toast Always Lands Butter-Side Down
description:
It's not bad luck: from a normal table, falling toast only has time for half a turn, so the buttered side ends up on the bottom.

Full video (7 everyday annoyances explained) on our channel: "Why Toast Lands Butter-Side Down, Shoelaces Untie and Earbuds Tangle".

Sources: R. A. J. Matthews, European Journal of Physics (1995); Bacon et al., American Journal of Physics (2001).
